Themes

A theme is one look for your product, with its own colors and fonts. From each color, the plugin builds a full palette and checks that text stays readable.

Color modes

A color mode is a version of the theme's colors, such as Light or Dark. Pick its canvas and the strength of its bolder text. Cards preview the first theme.

Generate

Choose what to write into this Figma file. Primitives and Theme are always included, because every other token links to them.
